capabilities: Render a timeline from a list of dates enclosed by | in a note
Create time spans from two dates separated by -
Add a today marker with now, today or present
Insert a timeline placeholder via the Timelive: New block command
Configure date parsing and display formats in settings
extras: Timelines render in Reading view, or in Live Editing mode when a note containing a timeline is embedded; a real use case is in the plugin's info.md.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in timeline view, and existing timeline plugins require code blocks that make formatting dates, links, images and videos harder.
summary: Renders timelines from lists of dates written directly in a note, without code blocks, supporting time spans and embedded media.
